modules.purpose: Declares the installed public C++20 API of the `onnx_world_model` library: the tensor value type, the error taxonomy, model and pipeline session contracts, and the fixed latent-dynamics compatibility types.

Implements the installed Python package: it wraps the compiled `_native` extension in typed classes and adds the preprocessing and generation layers that turn prompts, images, and videos into the tensors a Mobius package expects.

Implements the `onnx_world_model` C++ library declared in `include/onnx_world_model`: ONNX Runtime loading and session management, tensor marshalling, Mobius pipeline manifest parsing and validation, staged pipeline execution, and the fixed latent-dynamics compatibility layer.
Holds the C++ test executables that verify the library through its public headers, using in-process stub backends so the default run needs no ONNX Runtime library and no real ONNX model.
Holds the pytest suite that exercises the installed `onnx_world_model` Python package, including the compiled `_native` extension, through its public API.

files.purpose: Defines the pybind11 `_native` extension module that exposes the C++ runtime to Python and converts between NumPy arrays and onnx_world_model::Tensor.
Declares tensor signature metadata (TensorSpec, ModelMetadata), its validation helper, and the fixed latent-dynamics Backend contract with its step input and output structs.
Declares the library-wide error taxonomy: the ErrorCode category enum and the Error exception every public entry point throws on failure.
Declares runtime session and device-output configuration, execution-provider helpers and registration, and Model, the generic named-tensor ONNX graph session used by every higher-level API.
Umbrella convenience header that includes every public onnx_world_model header so a consumer needs a single include.

Declares the Mobius pipeline contract: manifest value types, the validated PipelineManifest and PipelinePackage loaders, the shareable Pipeline, the per-trajectory PipelineSession, its in-memory PipelineSessionSnapshot, and the session's named in-memory checkpoints.
Declares dense tensor data types, canonical device identities, the device-buffer contract, and the Tensor value type shared by every runtime layer.
Declares the fixed latent-dynamics compatibility API: WorldModel, which validates the three-input/four-output contract, and Rollout, which carries recurrent state between steps.
Declares the public `onnx_world_model` package surface by re-exporting the generation, pipeline, and preprocessing symbols that users are expected to import.

Wraps the `_native` extension in typed Python classes: it locates the ONNX Runtime library, maps manifest JSON to input, output, and stage specs, and exposes the generic model, pipeline, and latent-dynamics APIs.
Implements the modality-oriented `WorldModel` generation API by mapping text, image, video, and action requests onto the manifest stages of one Mobius pipeline package.
Decodes and normalizes visual inputs: it loads images and videos, resizes them onto the model grid, and packs frames into the patch-token layout the vision encoder expects.

Turns user prompts and media into the exact tensors a Mobius package expects: it renders chat templates, tokenizes text, packs latent tokens, and assembles reasoner and world-model inputs from the package manifest.
Loads the ONNX Runtime shared library at run time and binds the OrtApi function table once per process, so the library never links against a specific ORT binary.
Declares the RAII dynamic-library handle and the process-wide ONNX Runtime C API initializer used to load ORT without link-time coupling.
Implements execution-provider normalization and library registration, tensor-versus-signature validation, ModelMetadata lookups, and the validating Model facade.

Implements the ONNX Runtime ModelBackend: it shares one process-wide Ort::Env, creates component sessions, applies RuntimeOptions and execution providers, and uses I/O binding to retain ORT-owned output tensors on their assigned devices.
Declares the factory that builds an ONNX Runtime backed ModelBackend, execution-provider discovery, and process-wide provider-library registration.
Parses pipeline.json into a PipelineManifest and loads a Mobius package: it resolves component files inside the package root, opens their ONNX sessions, and builds the shareable Pipeline.
Implements the JSON field, token, and portable-name checks shared by pipeline manifest parsing and manifest semantic validation.
Declares the JSON field, token, and portable-name checks shared by pipeline manifest parsing and manifest semantic validation.

Validates the semantics of a parsed Mobius PipelineManifest: dataflow acyclicity, endpoint and dtype agreement, transform and generator programs, stage options, capabilities, and recurrent state lifecycles.
Declares the semantic validation pass that checks an already-parsed PipelineManifest, plus the component and endpoint lookups its callers reuse.

Implements PipelineSession, the per-trajectory execution engine that resolves stage inputs, runs component sessions, and owns recurrent state, diffusion schedulers, guidance, and token sampling, plus its in-memory snapshot, restore, fork, and named-checkpoint operations.
Implements canonical tensor devices, owned CPU buffers, checked tensor layout construction, host-access guards, CPU materialization, and copy-on-write mutation.
Implements the fixed latent-dynamics API: WorldModel enforces the three-input/four-output graph contract per step, and Rollout carries recurrent state across steps.
Standalone test executable for Model, runtime option defaults, provider helpers, and the named-tensor metadata contract, using an in-process AddOneBackend stub.

Standalone test executable for device-tensor preservation across PipelineSession: which paths keep a producer's TensorBuffer untouched and which materialize it on the host, driven by in-process stub backends.

Standalone test executable for the in-memory PipelineSession snapshot, restore, fork, and named-checkpoint contract: recurrent-state round trips, parent/child independence, package identity, device-buffer sharing, random-engine determinism, and checkpoint create/replace/restore/drop semantics.
Standalone test executable for the pipeline layer: manifest parsing and rejection cases, stage execution, guidance, schedulers, and recurrent state, driven by in-process stub backends.
Standalone test executable for Tensor: checked layout arithmetic, CPU and device-buffer construction, explicit CPU materialization, typed access, zero initialization, and copy-on-write semantics.
Provides the shared pytest fixtures that build throwaway Mobius packages, tokenizers, chat templates, and conditioning configuration for the Python test suite.
Tests the Python wrapper API in `_api.py`: model loading, metadata, execution-provider selection and rejection, named-tensor validation, and latent-dynamics stepping and rollout state.
Tests classifier-free guidance end to end by building small ONNX graphs with onnx_ir, assembling a guided package, and running the conditioned stage on ONNX Runtime.
Smoke-tests image-to-video generation through the `tools/image_to_video_smoke.py` entry point, covering the dry-run plan and, when a package is available, real video generation.
Tests the Pipeline and PipelineSession wrappers: manifest contract exposure, provider selection, graph-optimization levels, single-stage runs, stage subsets, and unknown-input rejection.
Tests the PipelineSessionSnapshot wrapper, the PipelineSession snapshot, restore, and fork methods, and the named in-memory checkpoint methods against a small counter package built with onnx_ir.
Tests the preprocessing and media layers: chat templating, tokenization, image and video patch packing, latent-token round trips, conditioning contracts, and guidance prompt handling.
Exports the small deterministic Mobius world-model and pipeline packages that the Python test fixtures load, with fixed head biases so predictions are reproducible.
Command-line smoke check for image-to-video generation that reports the prepared conditioning plan in dry-run mode or runs the full generation path against an exported package.
